screenSummary.playArea: Two Smart Carts, red and blue, sit touching in the middle of a track. The red cart's spring plunger is latched against the blue cart. Below the track, a graph shows each cart's position, velocity or force against time.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls choose the masses and the plunger position, tap the trigger, record, and fit a line to part of the graph. The Lab Tables button opens Tables 1 and 2.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Press Record, then Tap trigger. Fit the position graph after the launch to get each cart's velocity.

screenSummary.playArea: Two Smart Carts with Velcro bumpers facing each other sit on a track; the blue cart is at rest. Below the track, a graph shows each cart's position, velocity or force against time.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls choose the masses and push speed, push the red cart, record, and fit a line to part of the graph. The Lab Tables button opens Tables 1 and 2.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Press Record, then Push red cart. Fit before and after the collision to get the velocities.

screenSummary.playArea: Two Smart Carts with magnetic bumpers facing each other sit on a track; the blue cart is at rest. Below the track, a graph shows each cart's position, velocity or force against time.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls choose the masses and push speed, push the red cart, record, and fit a line to part of the graph. The Lab Tables button opens Tables 1 and 2.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Press Record, then Push red cart. Fit before and after the collision to get the velocities.

screenSummary.playArea: A graph shows the position, velocity or force of two real PASCO Smart Carts against time.
screenSummary.controlArea: Connect each Smart Cart over Bluetooth, choose which run you are doing, record, and fit a line to part of the graph. The Lab Tables button opens Tables 1 and 2.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Connect a cart, press Record, perform the collision on your real track, then Stop and fit.
